arxiv-1907-08429.title: Modeling Interface Charge Traps in Junctionless FETs, Including Temperature Effects
arxiv-1907-08429.creator: Amin Rassekh, Farzan Jazaeri, Morteza Fathipour, Jean-Michel Sallese
arxiv-1907-08429.description: Abstract In this paper, an analytical predictive model of interface charge traps in symmetric long channel double-gate junctionless transistors is proposed based on a charge-based model. Interface charge traps arising from the exposure to chemicals, high-energy ionizing radiation or aging mechanism could degrade the charge-voltage characteristics. The model is predictive in a range of temperature from 77K to 400K.

arxiv-2106-00335.title: Chasing maximal pro- p p Galois groups via 1-cyclotomicity
arxiv-2106-00335.creator: Claudio Quadrelli
arxiv-2106-00335.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Claudio Quadrelli. We prove that certain amalgamated free pro- p p products of Demushkin groups with pro- p p -cyclic amalgam cannot give rise to a 1-cyclotomic oriented pro- p p group, and thus do not occur as maximal pro- p p Galois groups of fields containing a root of 1 of order p p .

arxiv-2202-08097.title: Optimizing over Serial Dictatorships
arxiv-2202-08097.creator: Ioannis Caragiannis, Nidhi Rathi
arxiv-2202-08097.description: Abstract Motivated by the success of the serial dictatorship mechanism in social choice settings, we explore its usefulness in tackling various combinatorial optimization problems. We do so by considering an abstract model, in which a set of agents are asked to act in a particular ordering, called the action sequence .

arxiv-2206-13196.title: W-exchange contribution to the decays Ξ c ​ c + ⁣ + → Ξ c + ( ′ ) π + \Xi_{cc}^{++}\to\Xi_{c}^{+(\prime)}\pi^{+} using light-cone sum rules
arxiv-2206-13196.creator: Yu-Ji Shi 1 , Zhen-Xing Zhao 2 , Ye Xing 3 and Ulf-G. Meißner 1,4,5
arxiv-2206-13196.description: Abstract We calculate the W-exchange contribution to the Ξ c ​ c + ⁣ + → Ξ c + ( ′ ) π + \Xi_{cc}^{++}\to\Xi_{c}^{+(\prime)}\pi^{+} decay using light-cone sum rules. The two-particle light-cone distribution amplitudes of the pion are used as non-perturbative input for the sum rules calculation, and the perturbative kernel is calculated at the leading order.

arxiv-2209-13638.title: Outage Probability Analysis of HARQ-Aided Terahertz Communications
arxiv-2209-13638.creator: Ziyang Song 1 , Zheng Shi 1 , Qingping Dou 1 , Guanghua Yang 1 , Yunfei Li 2 , and Shaodan Ma 2 1 The School of Intelligent Systems Science and Engineering, Jinan University, China 2 The State Key Laboratory of Internet of Things for Smart City, University of Macau, China
arxiv-2209-13638.description: Abstract Although terahertz (THz) communications can provide mobile broadband services, it usually has a large path loss and is vulnerable to antenna misalignment. This significantly degrades the reception reliability. To address this issue, the hybrid automatic repeat request (HARQ) is proposed to further enhance the reliability of THz communications.

arxiv-2310-11107.title: Heat kernel fluctuations for stochastic processes on fractals and random media
arxiv-2310-11107.creator: Sebastian Andres, David Croydon and Takashi Kumagai
arxiv-2310-11107.description: Abstract It is well-known that stochastic processes on fractal spaces or in certain random media exhibit anomalous heat kernel behaviour. One manifestation of such irregular behaviour is the presence of fluctuations in the short- or long-time asymptotics of the on-diagonal heat kernel.

arxiv-2407-19795.title: VolDoGer : LLM-assisted Datasets for Domain Generalization in Vision-Language Tasks
arxiv-2407-19795.creator: Juhwan Choi, Junehyoung Kwon, Jungmin Yun, Seunguk Yu, YoungBin Kim
arxiv-2407-19795.description: Abstract Domain generalizability is a crucial aspect of a deep learning model since it determines the capability of the model to perform well on data from unseen domains. However, research on the domain generalizability of deep learning models for vision-language tasks remains limited, primarily because of the lack of required datasets.

arxiv-2411-14999.title: The EE-Classifier: A classification method for functional data based on extremality indexes
arxiv-2411-14999.creator: Catalina Lesmes, Francisco Zuluaga, Henry Laniado, Andres Gomez, Andrea Carvajal
arxiv-2411-14999.description: Abstract Functional data analysis has gained significant attention due to its wide applicability. This research explores the extension of statistical analysis methods for functional data, with a primary focus on supervised classification techniques. It provides a review on the existing depth-based methods used in functional data samples.

arxiv-2504-16147.title: Solid Target production for Astrophysical Reasearch: the European target laboratory partnership in ChETEC-INFRA
arxiv-2504-16147.creator: RobertaSpartà, Alexandra Spiridon, Rosanna Depalo, Denise Piatti, Antonio Massara, Nicoleta Florea, Marcel Heine, Radu-Florin Andrei, Beyhan Bastin, Ion Burducea, Antonio Caciolli, Matteo Campostrini, Sandrine Courtin, Federico Ferraro, Giovanni Luca Guardo, Felix Heim, Decebal Iancu, Marco La Cogna
arxiv-2504-16147.description: Abstract The joint work of European target laboratories in the ChETEC-INFRA project is presented, to face the new experimental challenges of nuclear astrophysics. In particular, results are presented on innovative targets of 12,13 C, 16 O, and 19 F that were produced, characterized, and, in some cases, tested under beam irradiation.

arxiv-2506-21958.title: Terminal Fano four folds in low codimension
arxiv-2506-21958.creator: Muhammad Imran Qureshi
arxiv-2506-21958.description: Abstract . We construct well-formed and quasismooth terminal Fano 4-folds of index 1 in low codimension containing at worst isolated orbifold points. We provide a certain classification of these varieties where their images under the anitcanonical embedding can be described as codimension 2, 3, or 4 subvarieties of some weighted projective space.

arxiv-2507-04899.title: Total sequences and the lower frame inequality Thanks: The author was partially supported by JSPS KAKENHI Grant Numbers 24K00527, 25H00588, 25H00593
arxiv-2507-04899.creator: Narutaka Ozawa
arxiv-2507-04899.description: Abstract . We prove that every total sequence in a Hilbert space satisfies the lower frame inequality after scaling. This solves A. Kulikov’s “exercise” at mathoverflow. 1991 Mathematics Subject Classification Primary 46B15; Secondary 42C15 Let H be a Hilbert space. We will view a vector v in H as a “column vector”, i.e., an operator from \mathbb{C} into H .

pmc-11365290.title: Letter to the editor "In vivo imaging in experimental spinal cord injury – Techniques and trends"
pmc-11365290.creator: Ramadurai Murugan
pmc-11365290.description: ow crucial in vivo imaging is to improving our knowledge of the mechanisms behind spinal cord injuries and potential treatments. The authors have emphasized the critical role that sophisticated imaging modalities like MRI, PET, and CT play in clarifying the intricate pathophysiology of spinal cord damage by combining the results of recent research.

pmc-11385898.title: Preoperative Patient Guidance and Education in Aesthetic Breast Plastic Surgery: A Novel Proposed Application of Artificial Intelligence Large Language Models
pmc-11385898.creator: Jad Abi-Rafeh, Brian Bassiri-Tehrani, Roy Kazan, Heather Furnas, Dennis Hammond, William P Adams, Foad Nahai
pmc-11385898.description: BackgroundAt a time when Internet and social media use is omnipresent among patients in their self-directed research about their medical or surgical needs, artificial intelligence (AI) large language models (LLMs) are on track to represent hallmark resources in this context.

pmc-12504517.title: Immunocompetent C57BL/6 syngeneic mouse ovarian cancer models with defined genetic alterations
pmc-12504517.creator: Hasmik Agadjanian, Beth Y Karlan, Christine S Walsh, Sandra Orsulic
pmc-12504517.description: Ovarian cancer remains one of the deadliest gynecologic cancers globally, with limited progress in early detection and treatment. Syngeneic mouse ovarian cancer cell lines, derived from immunocompetent mice, have become essential tools for studying ovarian cancer biology and assessing novel therapies.

pmc-12625913.title: Implementation and fidelity of reactive surveillance and response strategies for malaria elimination: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-12625913.creator: Win Han Oo, Nilar Aye Tun, Kaung Myat Thu, Julia C Cutts, Win Htike, Ei Phyu Htwe, May Chan Oo, Aung Khine Zaw, Paul Anthony Agius, Freya J I Fowkes
pmc-12625913.description: IntroductionTo achieve malaria elimination, case-based surveillance and response systems have been developed in endemic countries. This study systematically reviews the different types of reactive surveillance and response strategies for malaria, how they are being implemented, and their implementation fidelity, across different malaria elimination settings to inform reactive surveillance and response guidelines.

pmc-13014903.title: First-generation antipsychotic shortages in the United States: Utilization and switching patterns
pmc-13014903.creator: Ashley Tabah, Neel Swamy, Clayton English
pmc-13014903.description: BackgroundThe United States Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has declared an increasing number of psychotropic shortages, which may adversely affect health outcomes by forcing psychotropic switches or rationing. There is a paucity of literature describing the impact of psychotropic shortages.ObjectiveTo describe antipsychotic utilization patterns following FDA-declared antipsychotic shortages or discontinuations.

pmc-13248852.title: Rapid Remodeling of the Human Gut Microbiome in Response to Short‐Term Animal Product Restriction and Associations with Host Molecular Phenotypes
pmc-13248852.creator: Christina Emmanouil, Maria Anezaki, Alexandros Simistiras, Stavros Glentis, Nikolaos Scarmeas, Pantelis Hatzis, Konstantinos Rouskas, Antigone S Dimas
pmc-13248852.description: Diet strongly influences the gut microbiome, which in turn influences health, yet the effects of dietary patterns on microbiome composition and function in humans remain underexplored. A unique group of apparently healthy individuals from Greece, who alternate between omnivory and restriction of animal products for religious reasons (periodically restricted group, n = 200), has been profiled.

pmc-13399004.title: Endoscopic findings in patients with Shwachman–Diamond syndrome: A report from the North American Shwachman–Diamond syndrome registry
pmc-13399004.creator: Elizabeth Korn, Jane Koo, Diana Schwarz, Meghan Haney, Juan Putra, Jaeson Kim, Leah Cheng, Sarah Steltz, Lois Schwarz, Sara Loveless, Richard Cooper, Claire Dusa, Kasiani C Myers, Akiko Shimamura, Andrew Wehrman, Amit S Grover
pmc-13399004.description: ObjectivesShwachman–Diamond syndrome (SDS) is an inherited bone marrow failure disorder, and its endoscopic phenotype is poorly defined. We sought to characterize endoscopic findings in patients with genetically confirmed SDS.MethodsRetrospective registry study of 45 patients with biallelic Shwachman–Bodian–Diamond syndrome mutations and evaluable endoscopic procedures. Clinical, laboratory, imaging, endoscopic reports, and biopsy findings were extracted from patient medical records.

pmc-13525801.title: The Quantification Paradox in Gynecologic Color Doppler Ultrasound: From Spectral Indices to Microvascular Imaging and Artificial Intelligence
pmc-13525801.creator: Yeping Zhang, Juan Shi, Aihong Wang
pmc-13525801.description: Color Doppler ultrasound has long promised to convert tumor vascularity into an objective and reproducible measure for differentiating benign from malignant gynecologic disease. The historical record is more complicated. Quantitative spectral indices such as the resistance index, pulsatility index and peak systolic velocity were repeatedly proposed as objective discriminators, but their cutoffs did not become stable clinical standards.
